migration_status.compatibility_ownership: Cursor, Antigravity, and Factory canonical outputs use .adlc/compat-manifests; drift and unmanaged collisions fail closed, while transactional rollback remains limited to Claude Code and Codex.

migration_status.external_consumer_limitation: Unknown external forks and private consumers cannot be proven by repository-local evidence.
